generated_lifestyle.purpose: Illustrative lifestyle scene; not a documentary photograph or exact product specification.
generated_lifestyle.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium wellness furniture website editorial photograph. Generate one high-resolution square photograph inspired ONLY by the mid-page portrait scene in the provided tall reference layout: an adult woman in an elegant long ivory dress calmly reclining in a cream leather extended lounge chair in a serene monumental ivory travertine atrium. Sculptural, flowing translucent beige silk hangs horizontally high overhead, soft circular skylight, curved walls, warm reflected daylight, subtle floor reflections, airy quiet luxury. Whole woman including head and feet and the entire reclined chair visible in lower two thirds, tasteful realistic anatomy and upholstery. Match reference portrait’s palette and atmosphere. This is an illustrative lifestyle scene, not a factory or corporate documentary. Do not reproduce the webpage, collage, logos, copy, buttons, awards, certificates or navigation. Just a single crisp photographic scene with fine natural material detail, no text or watermark. Balanced full composition with safe margins for a square web panel.

client_evidence.method: Original pixels, displayed through CSS crop windows; no generated buildings, awards or certificates.
client_evidence.limitation: Rocket is now an independent, pixel-exact extraction from the supplied layout. Other documentary imagery uses separate client originals.
